reviews.text: This collagen bite has a pleasant pomegranate flavor that's fruity, refreshing, and not overly sweet. It's easy to chew, making it simple to fit into my daily routine. I can't comment on long-term beauty benefits yet, but it's definitely one of the more enjoyable collagen bites I've tried.
reviews.zh: 呢款膠原蛋白咬咬粒有好舒服嘅石榴味，有果香、清爽，唔會太甜。好易咬，所以好容易融入我每日嘅生活。我暫時未能評論長期嘅美容效果，但係絕對係我試過嘅膠原蛋白咬咬粒當中，比較好食嘅一款。

reviews.text: This one isn’t my favorite jelly because of the texture but taking collagen jelly has helped my nails grow A LOT! I used to bite my nails a lot and as you can see, my nails don’t grow the best and still grow kind of ridged, but they definitely have improved and I noticed after adding collagen jelly to my diet. I tried diffent packs and diffent brands, they’re all similar but my favorite was the white grape EVERDAZE, I’ll probably stick to those. Also to note, my nails don’t break as quick now and they don’t bend ugly.
reviews.zh: 呢款唔係我最鍾意嘅果凍，因為質地嘅關係，但係食膠原蛋白果凍真係令我嘅指甲增長咗好多！我以前好愛咬指甲，而且你睇到，我嘅指甲長得唔係好好，仲有啲縱紋，但係加咗膠原蛋白果凍落飲食之後，真係改善咗好多。我試過唔同包裝同唔同品牌，佢哋大致都差唔多，但係我最鍾意嘅係白葡萄 EVERDAZE，我可能會一直揀嗰款。另外要留意，我嘅指甲而家唔會咁易斷，亦唔會彎到好醜。

reviews.text:
I’ve been using BOTO Beauty Secret Pomegranate Collagen for a few weeks now, and I’m really enjoying it so far.

The pomegranate flavor is pleasant and not overly sweet, which makes it easy to drink every day. It blends well and feels light, not heavy or artificial like some collagen drinks can be.

After a couple of weeks, my skin looks more hydrated and has a healthier glow, and my overall routine just feels more complete. I like that it combines collagen with a refreshing fruity taste, making it feel both effective and enjoyable.

It’s a nice option if you want to support your beauty routine from within while actually enjoying the taste. I’d definitely continue using it
reviews.zh:
我用 BOTO Beauty Secret Pomegranate Collagen 已經幾個星期，到目前為止好享受。

石榴味道好舒服，唔會太甜，所以每日都容易飲。佢易溶，口感輕盈，唔會似某啲膠原飲品咁厚重或者有人工味。

幾個星期之後，我嘅皮膚睇落更加水潤，光澤更健康，而我嘅整體護理感覺更加完整。我鍾意佢將膠原蛋白同清新嘅果味結合，令佢又有效，又好食。

如果你想由內而外支持你嘅美容護理，同時又享受味道，呢款係一個好選擇。我一定會繼續用。

reviews.text: Hydration & Elasticity Support – Formulated with hyaluronic acid and vitamin C for smooth, glowing skin. Delicious Pomegranate Flavor. love it so much though I haven’t received it I already use it thay I purchased from the physical store😘😘
reviews.zh: 補水同彈性支持 – 配方含有透明質酸同維他命 C，令皮膚幼滑、有光澤。美味石榴味。好鍾意，雖然我仲未收到貨，我已經用緊我喺實體店買嘅。😘😘

reviews.text:
I’ve been taking the BOTO Beauty Secret Pomegranate Collagen and I’m very happy with it. The taste is pleasant and not too sweet, with a light pomegranate flavor that makes it easy to drink every day.

After consistent use, I’ve noticed my skin looks more hydrated, smoother, and healthier overall. It feels like my skin has a nice glow, and it looks more refreshed. I also like the convenient format, which fits easily into my daily routine.
reviews.zh:
我一直飲緊 BOTO Beauty Secret Pomegranate Collagen，我好滿意。味道好舒服，唔會太甜，石榴味好淡，所以每日都易飲。

持續飲用之後，我留意到皮膚整體睇落更加水潤、更加順滑、更健康。皮膚感覺有好靚嘅光澤，睇落亦更加清爽。我亦鍾意呢個方便嘅形式，好容易融入我嘅日常生活。

reviews.text: I am very happy with this collagen supplement and the results it has given me. After a few weeks of regular use, my skin feels more hydrated, smoother, and more elastic. I have also noticed that my hair looks shinier and my nails are stronger and less brittle. The collagen is easy to take and has no unpleasant taste, which makes it convenient for daily use. I truly feel more confident and energized since adding this product to my routine, and I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking to support their skin, hair, and overall health.
reviews.zh: 我對呢款膠原蛋白補充劑同佢帶嚟嘅效果好滿意。經過幾個星期定時服用，我嘅皮膚感覺更加水潤、更加順滑，亦更有彈性。我亦留意到頭髮更有光澤，指甲更加堅韌、冇咁易脆。膠原蛋白好易飲，亦冇難聞嘅味道，所以每日都好方便。自從加入呢款產品落我嘅日常，我真係感覺更有自信、更有精神，我一定會推薦畀所有想支持皮膚、頭髮同整體健康嘅人。

reviews.text: I’ve actually used this product before, and it quickly became one of my all-time favorites. The results were impressive, and I loved how consistently it performed every time I used it. Ever since I ran out, I’ve been waiting for the chance to get it again because nothing else felt quite the same. I’m really excited for this one to arrive so I can experience those results all over again!
reviews.zh: 我之前其實用過呢款產品，佢好快就成為我最愛嘅產品之一。效果好出色，每次用都好穩定，我好鍾意。自從用完咗之後，我一直等緊機會再買返，因為冇其他嘢感覺完全一樣。我好期待呢件產品到貨，咁我就可以再次體驗嗰啲效果！

reviews.text: I decided to try the Boto Collagen Sticks after using the Vitamin Village ones for a while, and I was pleasantly surprised. The jelly texture is just as convenient, making it easy to take on the go. The pomegranate flavor is slightly richer and more tart compared to Vitamin Village, which I actually really like. Both brands do a great job of masking the collagen taste, but Boto feels a bit more refreshing. I still love VV, but this one is definitely a strong contender for repurchasing!
reviews.zh: 我用咗 Vitamin Village 嘅膠原蛋白條一段時間之後，決定試吓 Boto Collagen Sticks，結果好出乎意料。果凍質地同樣方便，外出時容易攜帶。石榴味同 Vitamin Village 比較，稍為濃郁同帶少少酸，我其實好鍾意。兩個品牌都好好咁遮蓋咗膠原蛋白嘅味道，但係 Boto 就更加清新少少。我仍然好鍾意 VV，但係呢款絕對係我會再買嘅有力競爭者！
